response.rationale: All options are unmatched. Option B (Septic emboli with skin necrosis) is the most clinically relevant given the patient's bacteremia and necrotic plaques. Option A (Necrotizing fasciitis) and C (Necrotizing cellulitis) are less likely given the biopsy findings of epidermal and dermal necrosis without clear fascial involvement. Option D (Pressure necrosis) is least likely as the vignette states no devices were used on the ears.
